## Featured Projects

### NovaMind 256M - PIGPT 60M
Designed and trained a 256 million which is mixed architecture from top open source LLMs, which are openly available out there.
PiGPT 60M is a 60 million parameter GPT-style language model trained from scratch just following basic transformers architecture but with RoPE for encoding.
Stack: PyTorch, Transformers, CUDA, Distributed Training

### AI Agent Workflow Automation
LLM-based agent workflows using n8n and Claude API to automate consultant analytical
and reporting tasks.
Stack: n8n, Claude API, Python, REST APIs

### End-to-End Medallion Analytics Platform
Multi-layer data pipeline (Bronze/Silver/Gold) on AWS Databricks for analytics-ready
business reporting.
Stack: Python, SQL, Databricks, Apache Spark, dbt, Power BI
